characters.name: Maya
characters.look: a slim 8-year-old girl with deep brown skin, black hair in two tight braids, a yellow t-shirt, blue shorts and red sandals, an orange bead bracelet on one wrist

characters.name: Pip
characters.look: a small brown puppy with a white patch over one eye, floppy ears, a red collar and a tail that never stops wagging

characters.name: Tobi
characters.look: a sturdy 9-year-old boy with deep brown skin, short black hair under a blue cap, a green t-shirt, grey shorts and a whistle on a cord round his neck

characters.name: Mama Nkechi
characters.look: a broad market woman in her fifties with deep brown skin, a tall orange head tie over her hair, a purple kaftan, a brown wrapper and a cloth bag of peppers over one shoulder
traits: knows every dog on the street

sets.name: The Compound
sets.look: a small walled compound in a Lagos neighbourhood: a red-roofed bungalow, a mango tree with a tyre swing, a blue bucket and a metal bowl by the step, clothes drying on a line

sets.name: The Market Road
sets.look: a busy open-air market beside a Lagos road: stalls of tomatoes, peppers and yams under striped umbrellas, cardboard boxes stacked on the kerb, a yellow danfo bus waiting beyond

sets.name: The Danfo
sets.look: the inside of a yellow danfo minibus: worn brown bench seats, a beaded cover on the steering wheel, stickers on the glass, the road sliding past the open door

sets.name: The Open Field
sets.look: a patch of open grass at the end of the street: a low concrete wall, a lopsided goalpost, tall grass at the edges and palm trees against the sky beyond

world.culture: a Yoruba family in a busy city neighbourhood
world.landscape: flat sandy streets, low bungalows with walled compounds, mango trees, a crowded market road
world.homes: a small bungalow with a walled compound, a mango tree and a tyre swing
